chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 64: Ji Ning Discovers the Nine Volumes of Formations
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning inspects his spoils from the aquatic palace, finding a priceless formation legacy. He arrives at the Blacktooth Tribe and meets Chuncao's sickly brother, Qingshi.
og_title: Peerless Genius Awakens: Ji Ning Inherits a Lost Art
og_description: A calm night of sorting treasures reveals the seeds of future power. Ji Ning discovers the Nine Volumes of Formations, a legacy that will change his path forever.
twitter_title: Ji Ning meets Qingshi and finds a formation master’s legacy!
twitter_description: After the bloody battle at Winged Serpent Lake, Ji Ning gets a new kind of upgrade: a brain upgrade. The Nine Volumes of Formations has arrived.
